CustomField.formula: IF( SBQQ__EndDate__c < TODAY() , "Expired" , IF( SBQQ__TerminatedDate__c <= TODAY(), "Terminated", "Active") )
CustomField.inlineHelpText: If Subscription End Date is in the past, it is Expired. If the Subscription Termination Date is today or in the past it is Terminated. Otherwise, it is Active.
CustomField.label: Subscription Status
